skill.displayName: SprayPaint Stencil Maker Online – Create Custom Spray Paint Stencils from Any Image – API-powered
skill.summary: AI spray paint stencil maker — convert a photo into a black-and-white spray paint stencil

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-spray-paint-openapi-skill.
- Converts photos into black-and-white spray paint stencils via WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication.
- Provides endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and image asset upload.
- Includes clear API security guidance and environment variable usage for API keys.
